newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian Merukh says in talks with Bre-X.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian Merukh says in talks with Bre-X.

text.p: Indonesian businessman Jusuf Merukh said on Wednesday he had held talks with officials from Bre-X Minerals Ltd of Canada on an ownership dispute over the huge Busang gold find in East Kalimantan.
"As a result of these discussions, the parties are optimistic that an early resolution can be achieved," he said in a statement dated December 3 but released on Wednesday.
Bre-X official John Felderhof confirmed he held talks with Merukh on Tuesday but said it was "just an exchange of ideas".
"They had their point of view, and we had ours. It was just an exchange of ideas," he told Reuters.
Felderhof said no meetings were scheduled for Wednesday. He declined to comment on whether the talks touched on the ownership dispute between Bre-X and Merukh.
In a separate letter hand-delivered on Wednesday to Umar Said, the Secretary-General of the Mines Department, Merukh informed the official of his talks with Bre-X.
"The meeting took place in Jakarta and substantial progress was achieved towards a settlement of the ownership dispute ..." said the letter, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters.

Merukh said in the letter the Jakarta-based mining community was very concerned over the Ministry's attempt to "force Bre-X ... to give up 75 percent in favour of Barrick, which has no status or legal right to an interest in the application area".
Copies of the letter were sent to President Suharto and Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana, Merukh said.

"Resolution of the dispute between Bre-X and the minorities, which has the potential to delay the development of Busang even if Barrick and Bre-X do reach agreement, should be regarded as a priority by the Ministry," the letter said.
Merukh called on the Ministry to extend its December 4 deadline imposed on Bre-X to reach an agreement with Barrick Gold Corp.
Merukh's company PT Krueng Gasui (KG) and Australia's Golden Valley Mines NL on Wednesday also released the statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
Golden Valley has a technical assistance and financial deal with Merukh to develop Busang.
